# precision_vectors.txt — shared vectors for the stage-3 PRECISION fold, C++ and Python.
#
# Read by tests/test_precision.cpp (firmware/libraries/Precision) AND
# tools/stage3/test_stage3_gate.py (tools/stage3/stage3_gate.py, which is pw1_fold.py's own
# parser, residuals and arithmetic with PW-1b's spans). docs/design/rfc0011-stage3.md §7.
#
# The `--- expect` lines are GENERATED by `stage3_gate.py --fill-vectors` (i.e. by pw1's code)
# and committed; the C++ fold must reproduce them. One case is pinned by hand as well:
# `hand_worked_acoustic` is pw1's 5-residual example (var 4090, prec 170) — the test checks
# that literal too, so a generator bug cannot silently re-baseline the file.
#
# Format: `=== <name> chan:<link|entity|motion|acoustic>`, then one `--- episode lon:<n>` per
# episode followed by its record text (header line first), then `--- expect k:v ...`.
# Pinned eol=lf (.gitattributes: tests/vectors/*).
